Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) vs NVIDIA (NVDA): on the same formula, their operating margins are 49.7 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AMD: $34.6B · NVDA: $215.9B
• Revenue growth — AMD: +34.3% · NVDA: +65.5%
• Operating margin — AMD: 10.7% · NVDA: 60.4%
• Net margin — AMD: 12.5% · NVDA: 55.6%
• Free cash flow margin — AMD: 19.4% · NVDA: 44.8%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AMD: 20.5% · NVDA: 68.3%

Different fiscal years: AMD Dec 27, 2025 · NVDA Jan 25, 2026. The periods are not identical.
